front: Which standard commands / workflow do you use for cli?
back: helm repo add <namespace> <url> <flag>; → helm repo add ingress-nginx https://kubernetes.github.io/ingress-nginx → help repo udpate; → help search repo nginx; → help search repo ingress;

front: Given a broken cli setup, what is your first validation command?
Design a minimal correct cli setup for a small production service.
back: Checklist: (1) mental-model constraint, (2) required config/commands, (3) health/triage check, (4) one failure mode to avoid. Anchor: helm repo add <namespace> <url> <flag>;

The kind field is not part of the basic required fields, but it can be added to specify the type of chart. The kind field should be used for custom resources, as it helps Helm understand how to process the resource during installation and upgrade
